title: Deterministic patrol loop for creatures
summary: A creature that walks a closed path should derive position from elapsed time, so every frame and every replay shows the same state.
applies_when: animated creature or vehicle following a path
scene that must look identical on reload or when captured

values.phase_offset_per_agent: golden-angle step so agents never march in sync

checks: position(t) is a pure function of time, not of accumulated deltas
no agent teleports at the loop seam
pausing the renderer and resuming does not shift the phase
limits: does not cover collision avoidance or crowd interaction
no claim about real animal gait
